subheadline: Desiderio makes its own choices for styling and uses standard TYPO3 for everything else.

items.title: Content Blocks 2.2
items.description: Each element is a Content Block: fields, template and backend preview in one folder.

items.title: OKLCH design tokens
items.description: Tailwind v4 semantic tokens set every colour, so theme presets change the site consistently.

items.title: Container queries
items.description: Elements adapt to the column they sit in, not only to the screen width. They work in any layout.

items.title: BEM component CSS
items.description: Each element has predictable class names, and the template audit allows no inline styles. Overrides stay small and targeted.

items.title: Fluid 5 components
items.description: 62 typed components (atoms, molecules, layouts and organisms) keep your own templates as short as the bundled ones.

items.title: Workspaces-safe seeding
items.description: The demo commands respect workspaces and can run again at any time without creating duplicates.
